header.description: What: Simulated devices SD-S1 (§5a, R3-3 / R5-8). The dv-paused-operation run - the Observer ranges a marker 450 m away and opens the rangefinder's menu INSIDE a 120-frame pause - recorded FULL and REVIEWED: at 4 s the check enters a During Action Review, looks back at every earlier second, returns to live and runs on (scripts: --verify dv-replay-hud --verify-review-at 4). Judge: (1) live, the device answers in pause exactly as dv-paused-operation (menu open, the range measured as a PREVIEW, the HUD shows it); (2) the review shows the live world at every second looked back at - the device's recorded state the HUD is drawn from (its panel with the range text, its spot, its pose) included - and the return gives the world back. Not judged yet: the HUD's TEXT in the review at a paused wall-clock frame. Fail: a difference between the review and the live run. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh dv-replay-hud
